description: This file defines the TaxComponentHistory entity class used to represent historical records of tax component percentages over specific date ranges within the Fineract project.

classes.name: TaxComponentHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of tax component percentages with associated date ranges.

methods.name: createTaxComponentHistory
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new TaxComponentHistory object with specified percentage and date range.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the tax component history period.

methods.name: endDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the tax component history period.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpToAndIncluding
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the start and end dates, inclusive.

methods.name: getPercentage
methods.description: Returns the tax percentage value for this history record.
